title: Midnight Balcony Radio Club
oneLiner: A dreamy social listening prototype where users build a tiny after-hours radio room with anonymous dedications, ambient visuals, and rotating city-night moods.
targetUser: Night owl creatives, remote workers, and lonely scrollers who want a softer shared ritual than chat-heavy social apps.
keyUX: Enter a mood station, pin a dedication or memory to the room, and watch the space visually change as the night's emotional mix evolves.
stitchPrompt: Design a whimsical desktop social listening prototype called Midnight Balcony Radio Club for night owl creatives and remote workers seeking a softer sense of company. It should let users enter a tiny after-hours radio room, leave anonymous dedications, tune ambient visuals, and watch the emotional tone of the space shift throughout the night. Include an immersive night-room stage, a mood station selector, an anonymous dedication feed, live ambient controls, a city mood meter, and a collectible scene capture tray. Design direction: use a playful-experimental aesthetic with nocturnal gradients, dreamy glow, layered translucency, rounded expressive controls, and intimate cinematic atmosphere that feels tender, shareable, and slightly surreal.
